_meta.purpose: Stage 5 draft schedule blocks for all 14 named NPCs. Paste each npc's `schedule` array (and optional `beats` array) over the matching key in src/data/npcs.json. Nothing else in npcs.json changes.
_meta.coordinateSpace: NATIVE 640x360 plate px, identical to src/data/locations/<id>.location.json. LocationData.ts multiplies by world.scale (3) exactly once.
_meta.anchorContract: station.{x,y} is the sprite ORIGIN (bottom-centre). The character's FEET are at (x, y+15) native. Every station in this file has been verified walkable at (x, y+15) against assets/scenes/masks/<id>-walk.png, the same test tools/validate-location-data.cjs applies to spawns.

newFields.station: {x,y} native. Where the NPC stands for this slot.
newFields.facing: down|up|left|right. Initial facing on arrival; the walk itself sets facing en route.
newFields.idle: business-idle loop key. See living-world-spec.md section 2 for the vocabulary and the Tier-0 fallback.
newFields.route: Optional waypoint HINTS between the previous slot's station and this one. A* over the walk mask fills the gaps; these exist to force a specific, readable line (down the middle of the street, along the quay edge) instead of the shortest diagonal.
newFields.arriveBy: Hour by which the NPC must be standing at `station`. The walk begins (arriveBy - travelMinutes) so the transition is visible BEFORE the hour rolls over, not after.
newFields.onCameraWalk: true = walk if the player is in the same location; teleport + 400ms cross-fade otherwise. false = always teleport (used only for cross-location moves).
newFields.exit: For available:false slots that mean 'gone indoors'. The NPC walks to {x,y}, plays `effect`, then fades out over 350ms. door names the plate door/prop it is using.
newFields.enter: Mirror of exit for the slot that brings them back: fade in at {x,y}, then walk to `station`.

_meta.beats: Per-NPC moment list, independent of the slot grid. `at` is HH:MM game time, `duration` is game-MINUTES, `idle` overrides the slot idle for the duration, `face` turns the NPC toward a point. A beat never moves the NPC unless it carries its own `station`.
_meta.verification: node tools/validate-location-data.cjs must be extended to run the feet-walkability test over every schedule station and every route waypoint. See living-world-spec.md section 8, assertion A1.
